state: We have now written three Can business-app drafts and observed a concrete repetition. Private chat and image generation each author three start/cancel/reconcile completion bridges, one provider-changed bridge, a local Observation event, a stored sequence/state/content mirror and one business consumer. Both already require a shared durable adapter that validates same-source/revision frozen request digest, normalizes cumulative snapshots, rejects changed duplicate sequence/terminal regressions, preserves unknown, isolates cancellation, and finalizes files. The app-specific consumer reserves/settles tokens or image jobs and creates an immutable assistant turn or finalized output records. Existing Can has durable typed send, delivery(Target) associated receipts with field grants/read revision fencing, verified events, ordinary owner transactions and authorized UI polling. Three prior design comparisons favored standard typed snapshot capabilities over a broad run DSL or lossless token log, but did not compare storing normalized progress on the existing delivery association. New user guidance explicitly values removing repeated app infrastructure. Requirements: same private/revocable workflow, complete branches/template revisions/reviewed gallery, resource ceilings, reconnect without resubmission, no exact token replay, separate delivery success and generation completion, targeted cancellation including cancel-before-submit tombstones, unknown acceptance recovery, immutable terminal execution plus one later usage settlement. Pre-ack progress must correlate to an admitted original request, never raw source text alone. Replacing a business receipt must not let an old run update the new handle; old work can settle only its own ledger. Callback failures cannot roll back accepted provider evidence. Final content/usage notifications must remain durably recoverable. All options need those guarantees and none is implemented. Compare a bounded primitive choice, not provider implementation or a general workflow engine.

observed_progress.instructions: Which surface should the complete Chat/Creative drafts now use, balancing concise authorship, separation of protocol from business, explicit authority/recovery, implementation cost and specification risk?

criteria.app_snapshots: Keep current ordinary standard capability changed events plus operation results. Apps retain their sequence/state mirror and completion bridges, with shared adapters doing normalization. It adds no receipt API behavior and makes all projection updates visible in source, but repeats protocol-shaped handlers and UI progress depends on successful business projection callbacks.
criteria.associated_progress: Extend existing delivery(Target) only when its standard manifest declares an observable operation: read-only typed progress and Target.progressed. The binding declares once how original start request, cancel/reconcile results and changed events feed that receipt. Runtime commits monotone latest progress under existing receipt read fences and file/field permissions, and durable progress notifications target the original delivery. Apps derive visible state from progress and keep one idempotent consumer for token/job settlement and domain records. This removes mirrors/bridges and isolates UI from callback failure, but adds manifest correlation, mutable receipt data/provenance, replay and fixture semantics to specify.
criteria.run_construct: Introduce a distinct first-class run type and start/stop/reconcile/observe syntax with its own standard generated UI/lifecycle. Adapters still prove provider facts and apps still own permissions and domain effects. This may be clearer and shorter for future long-lived work, but adds a broader type/effect/authority/JS lowering surface and migration rules beyond extending existing delivery associations.
